name: code-flow-canvas
description: Python codebase as a live node canvas

commands.title: Code Flow: Open Canvas in New Window

viewsWelcome.contents:
The canvas opens when you click this icon.
[$(type-hierarchy) Open Canvas](command:codeflow.open)
[$(link-external) Open in New Window](command:codeflow.detach)
[$(beaker) Trace Tests](command:codeflow.traceTests)
[$(debug-alt) Trace Launch Config…](command:codeflow.traceLaunch)
Right-click a function in the editor or a .py file in the Explorer for Follow Forward / Follow Backward.

codeflow.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter. Empty = the workspace .venv / venv / env, then the Python extension's selection, then py -3 / python3.

codeflow.ignoreLibraryConnections.description: Hide wires to/from third-party and stdlib code.

enumDescriptions: Levels are relative to the selected node: its args/return = 1, its calls = 2/3. No selection: caller's level.
Each wire has one level (caller's view) regardless of selection.
codeflow.levelMode.description: How wire levels are evaluated by the level filters.

codeflow.nestSingleUse.description: Nest functions/lambdas/properties with a single call site inside their caller.

enumDescriptions: Double-click opens a tab containing only that function; saving writes back into the real file.
Double-click opens the real file with the function selected and everything else folded.
codeflow.editorMode.description: How double-clicking a node opens its code.

codeflow.collapseThreshold.description: Above this many function nodes, start in classes/modules-only view.

codeflow.edgeThreshold.description: Above this many wires, wires-on-demand mode turns on automatically.

codeflow.groupByFile.description: Draw one area per file. Off: a flat left-to-right flow with classes as frames. Positions are kept separately for each mode.

codeflow.anim.maxBalls.description: Most ball animations in flight at once while tracing (0 = wires only flash). Extra steps on a busy wire add to its ×n counter.

codeflow.log.maxEntries.description: Entries kept in the canvas footer log (oldest dropped first).

codeflow.bridgeHidden.description: When filters hide a node that sits between two shown ones (A calls hidden B, B calls C; or A's return value flows through B into C), draw a dashed "via B" wire from A to C so the flow stays readable.

codeflow.log.showHidden.description: Log: also show calls of nodes the canvas currently hides (filters, focus, follow chain). Toggle in the log header.

enumDescriptions: Follows the VS Code theme (switches to high-contrast in a high-contrast theme)
Thick white wires, colour carries little
codeflow.colorScheme.description: Colours of nodes, wires, ports and types on the canvas.

codeflow.showGuideOnStart.description: Show the one-page guide the first time the canvas opens.

codeflow.follow.stepMs.description: Follow mode: how long each step's ball animation takes. The traced program waits for it.

enumDescriptions: Only steps on nodes visible under the current filters pause
Only steps on the selected node and its direct neighbours pause
Every project call and return pauses
codeflow.follow.scope.description: Follow mode: which steps the program waits on (the others run at full speed).

codeflow.follow.camera.description: Follow mode: move the camera with the ball (pan), also zoom in to it (panZoom), or leave it (off).

enumDescriptions: Pack the shown nodes until the filters / focus change; saved positions come back.
Pack the shown nodes and save those positions.
Never move nodes; only zoom to fit.
codeflow.pack.description: Fit (with some nodes hidden) and Follow Forward / Backward move the shown nodes close together (callers left, callees right) before fitting the view.

codeflow.intercept.timeoutSec.description: A paused program (intercept or follow) continues on its own after this many seconds (0 = wait forever).

codeflow.wiresOnDemand.description: Hide wires unless their node is selected or the wire is locked.

codeflow.trace.valueDepth.description: How many levels deep traced values are captured for the expandable value views.

codeflow.trace.valueItems.description: How many items of each list / dict / object are captured for the value views.

codeflow.trace.maxValueLength.description: Max characters of a traced value repr.

codeflow.trace.persistValues.description: Keep last trace values across sessions (stored in workspace state, not the layout file).

scripts.build: npm run build:ext && npm run build:web
